from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashStatementLine(BaseModel):
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str = Field(description="The specific line item label found in the statements (e.g., 'Cash', 'Cash and Restricted Cash')")
    amount: float = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance")
    unit_scale: str = Field(description="The scale unit of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    date_or_period: str = Field(description="The date or period the balance refers to")
    statement_type: str = Field(description="The type of financial statement (e.g., 'Balance Sheet', 'Cash Flow')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_statements: list[CashStatementLine]
